title: Vercel Container Registry repositories can now be made public
summary: Vercel Container Registry now lets you make a repository public, so anyone with a Vercel account can pull and use its images. Sharing already granted read access to up to 100 teams, and making a repository public opens that access to every Vercel team rather than a named set. Public access is read-only, so anyone can pull and use the images but cannot push, delete, or otherwise change the repository. Repositories stay private by default. summary: Audit Log Drains now stream your team's audit events into Datadog , Splunk , and Panther , joining the existing custom HTTPS endpoint and Amazon S3 destinations. summary: Seedance 2.5 from ByteDance is now available on AI Gateway. It generates up to 30 seconds in a single clip, holding camera movement and continuity without stitching shots together in post. Short clips can also be extended with character, scene, and camera movement carried over.
